title: Terrace Water Line
premise: A long farming drama under emerald terraces and silver morning-mist lines. Xiao Zhou and A-Xiang are easily confused by looks; the waterwheel spine goes intact→broken-teeth→repaired with new teeth; after the ox cart Green-Seedling wrecks it must be avoided; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). present items may be objects carrying confusable_with/count/anchor. op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.
_state_note: Entities with state machines use states; others use appearance. Flashbacks may write state on present items.

states.prime_watcher: Uncle Ridge in his fifties, short gray hair, dark-green straw cape and coarse trousers, bamboo water gauge at the waist, calves caked in mud, steady eyes.
states.waist_wound_cane: The same Uncle Ridge after a waist injury: hard to bend, walking slowly on a yellow-rattan cane, still in that faded dark-green straw cape.
states.deceased: Uncle Ridge has closed his eyes in death, lying still on the field-hut narrow couch, face peaceful, no breath left.

states.young_farmer: Young Xiao Zhou: a lean transplanting apprentice of fourteen or fifteen, cyan-green headscarf, gray-brown short jacket, straw-braid wrist rope on the left, bright stubborn eyes.
states.adult_successor: Adult Xiao Zhou: a broad-shouldered water watcher in his twenties, still wearing the cyan-green headscarf and left-wrist straw rope, steady expression.

states.intact_turning: A wooden waterwheel spine standing by the ridge, paddles intact, clear water line flowing in the spine trough, creaking as it turns.
states.teeth_jammed: The same waterwheel spine: paddles with broken teeth jammed, spine trough dry, axle skewed.
states.teeth_replaced: After new paddles, the waterwheel spine turns again; new-wood patches remain on the spine, distinct from the first intact state.

states.intact: An oil-paper-covered water-log book, cover lettered 'South Slope Nine Mounds', pages filled in brush with sluice times and water levels.
states.mud_stained: The same water-log book soaked through with field mud water, cover warped and wrinkled, writing smeared into mud blotches.

states.intact: A green-lacquered two-wheeled ox cart, white letters 'Green-Seedling' on the sides, straw-lined bed for hauling seedlings.
states.ridge_overturned: The green-lacquer ox cart overturned on the ridge, sides split, straw scattered—wreckage that can no longer haul seedlings.

states.young_visitor: Young A-Xiang: face nearly identical to Xiao Zhou's, but turmeric-yellow headscarf, bamboo-joint bracelet on the right wrist, more playful look.
states.adult_mat_weaver: Adult A-Xiang: face nearly identical to adult Xiao Zhou's, still turmeric-yellow headscarf and bamboo-joint bracelet, reed-mat roll on the shoulder.

E7.name: South-slope water shed
E7.appearance: The South-slope water shed at the terrace crown, bamboo frame and thatch roof; from under it, mound after mound of water-mirror paddies.

E8.name: Nine-mound ridges
E8.appearance: Winding Nine-mound ridges, mud surface smooth, a waterwheel on one side, morning mist drifting like silver thread.

E9.name: granary dark lane
E9.appearance: A narrow dark lane to the granary storehouse, grain bins and bamboo baskets stacked on both sides, only dim oil-lamp yellow.

E10.name: old field-hut ruins
E10.appearance: Old field-hut ruins at the mountain foot; collapsed mud walls and half a stone mill, weeds pushing from the cracks.

E11.name: canal-opening brass plaque
E11.appearance: A canal-opening brass plaque nailed to the water-shed stone post, engraved with Uncle Ridge's name and the canal year, mottled verdigris.

E12.name: bamboo water gauges
E12.appearance: Three graduated bamboo water gauges stuck by length into mud beside the ridge water mouth.

E13.name: Iron-Ox seedling tractor
E13.appearance: A brand-new orange-red walking tractor, 'Iron Ox' sprayed on the nose, no ox-cart shafts—utterly unlike Green-Seedling.

E14.name: Water officer Old Qin
E14.appearance: Water officer Old Qin in his fifties, short gray hair and dark-green straw cape close to Uncle Ridge's build, but an enamel water-works badge on his chest.

E15.name: oil-paper lanterns
E15.appearance: A row of five oil-paper lanterns hung on iron nails under the South-slope water shed eaves, shades polished clear.

E16.name: sluice-opening gongs
E16.appearance: Two sluice-opening copper gongs hung under the water-shed beam, faces chiseled with 'Water', trembling lightly when wind rises.

E17.name: neighboring-mound youth Daosui
E17.appearance: Neighboring-mound youth Daosui, fourteen or fifteen, cyan-green headscarf; at a glance like young Xiao Zhou, but no straw wrist rope on the left, shy eyes.

E18.name: spare small waterwheel
E18.appearance: A half-person-tall spare small waterwheel, shaped like the waterwheel spine but with smaller paddles and a bamboo frame.

E19.name: earth-yellow flat cart
E19.appearance: A strange earth-yellow flat cart loaded with manure, no Green-Seedling lettering—not the same as Green-Seedling.

features.E2: Xiao Zhou: cyan-green headscarf, straw wrist rope on the left.
features.E6: A-Xiang: face nearly identical to Xiao Zhou's, but turmeric-yellow headscarf, bamboo-joint bracelet on the right wrist.

lookalike_pairs.note: Hard misidentification sample: Xiao Zhou and A-Xiang look alike; tell them apart only by headscarf color and wrist rope/bracelet.

scenes.setting: South-slope water shed watch (introduce five oil-paper lanterns · two sluice-opening gongs)
actions: At dusk Uncle Ridge climbs to the South-slope water shed; the waterwheel spine creaks turning water by the ridge.

actions.action: A row of five oil-paper lanterns hangs under the South-slope water shed eaves; Uncle Ridge polishes each shade.
Two sluice-opening gongs hang under the water-shed beam; Uncle Ridge reaches up and lets the faces tremble lightly.

actions: Uncle Ridge circles the waterwheel spine, checking paddles and whether the spine trough runs clear.
From the shed mouth Uncle Ridge watches the sky beyond the layered terraces.

actions.action: The intact waterwheel spine quietly turns a clear water line beside the Nine-mound ridges.

actions: Uncle Ridge sits on a bamboo chair and dozes by the oil-paper lanterns.
Night mist climbs the ridge; Uncle Ridge tightens the collar of his dark-green straw cape.

scenes.setting: Logging the water-log book
actions: Uncle Ridge opens the water-log book and brush-notes that night's sluice time.
Uncle Ridge draws a water-level curve in the water-log book.
Uncle Ridge closes the water-log book and sets it back in the shed's clay jar.

actions.action: Water-glimmer from the waterwheel spine sweeps Uncle Ridge's cheek.

actions: Uncle Ridge gently wipes mud flecks from the bamboo water gauges with a cloth.

scenes.setting: Nine-mound ridges greet the apprentice (introduce three bamboo water gauges)
actions: On the morning Nine-mound ridges, Uncle Ridge greets young Xiao Zhou driving the green-lacquer Green-Seedling.

actions.action: Xiao Zhou steadies Green-Seedling and lifts seedling bundles from the bed to the paddy edge.
Uncle Ridge points to the three bamboo water gauges by the water mouth and teaches Xiao Zhou to read the marks.
Xiao Zhou squats on the mud ridge and curiously touches the water mirrors in the morning mist.
Uncle Ridge points to the valley and explains the pumping order to Xiao Zhou.
Xiao Zhou looks back at parked Green-Seedling, eyes full of longing.

actions: They lean side by side on a ridge stone post, listening to the waterwheel creak.

scenes.setting: Granary dark lane (only A-Xiang)
actions: In the granary dark lane, A-Xiang with the turmeric-yellow headscarf turns from behind a grain bin.
A-Xiang fiddles with bamboo baskets in the dark lane; the bamboo-joint bracelet taps the rim.
A-Xiang taps drying days on the wall with a finger and smiles playfully.
A-Xiang carries a reed-mat roll through the shadows of the granary dark lane.
The oil lamp flickers; A-Xiang stops to listen to the waterwheel outside.

scenes.setting: Lookalike pair shared screen
actions: On the Nine-mound ridges Xiao Zhou and A-Xiang stand side by side—one cyan-green headscarf, one turmeric-yellow.
Xiao Zhou hands a bamboo water gauge to A-Xiang; they smile at each other.
A-Xiang tidies Xiao Zhou's headscarf; they walk slowly along the mud ridge.
Xiao Zhou and A-Xiang part at the west end of the ridge and walk opposite ways.
Morning mist rises; their backs—one cyan, one yellow—gradually pull apart.

scenes.setting: Water-log book mud-stained
actions: Months later at night, Uncle Ridge keeps watch alone in the South-slope water shed; the waterwheel spine turns quietly.

actions.action: Uncle Ridge opens the water-log book and finds the cover soaked through with field mud water, writing smeared into mud blotches.

actions: Uncle Ridge wipes moss from the waterwheel spine paddles.
From the shed mouth Uncle Ridge looks toward the pitch-black Nine-mound ridges.

actions.action: The outline of the waterwheel spine slowly appears under the oil-paper lanterns.

actions: Uncle Ridge slips the stained water-log book into an oil-paper bag and sighs.

scenes.setting: Farm seasons turning (filler · stretch the interval)
actions: Seasons turn; day after day Uncle Ridge climbs to the South-slope water shed.
Another snowy night Uncle Ridge wraps his cape tight and keeps watch by the waterwheel spine.
At spring-planting sluice open, Uncle Ridge checks mound numbers inside the shed.
At high-summer noon Uncle Ridge wipes the sun-hot bamboo rail outside the shed.
Autumn rain falls on end; the waterwheel spine's water line goes white in the fog.
Another New Year's Eve Uncle Ridge keeps vigil alone in the South-slope water shed till dawn.
On the eve of grain-drying Uncle Ridge clears the water mouth two hours early.
On a full-moon night Uncle Ridge tops oil in every oil-paper lantern.
When a cold snap hits Uncle Ridge hangs wind-break grass curtains on the shed door.
Around Qingming Uncle Ridge sweeps leaves and gravel from the Nine-mound ridges.
In plum-rain season Uncle Ridge repeatedly checks ridge seepage.

scenes.setting: Long-night water-watch supplement
actions: For three rainless nights straight Uncle Ridge pins sluice times dead tight.
One night the level drops sharply; Uncle Ridge has to open a side ditch.
The waterwheel hesitates; Uncle Ridge quickly checks the paddles.
At three in the morning Uncle Ridge drinks ice-cold tea from a coarse porcelain bowl.
Inside the shed he sorts the bamboo water gauge numbers.
The sluice-opening gongs tremble lightly in the wind; Uncle Ridge looks up to listen.
When the sky pales Uncle Ridge notes the last sluice of the night.
Before leaving the shed he glances once more at the waterwheel spine's intact paddles.

scenes.setting: Ridge rounds (recall bamboo water gauges · earth-yellow flat cart)
actions: At dawn Uncle Ridge patrols the Nine-mound ridges; green-lacquer Green-Seedling sits by a stone post.

actions.action: Uncle Ridge crouches to check Green-Seedling's wheels and straw pad.
Uncle Ridge walks to the water mouth; those earlier three bamboo water gauges still stand neatly stuck.
A strange earth-yellow flat cart rolls the ridge road—manure in the bed, not Green-Seedling.
Uncle Ridge stands on the mud ridge noting last night's peak water level.
Uncle Ridge replants the bird-scare crow figure upright.

actions: Far morning mist withdraws, revealing deeper valley shadow.

scenes.setting: Night of flood (teeth jammed · Green-Seedling overturns)
actions: Mountain flood surges; the South-slope water shed trembles in the water roar; the waterwheel spine shakes hard.
Turbid flow scours the ridge; Uncle Ridge rushes to the floodgate plank.

actions.action: With a dull crack the waterwheel spine paddles jam on broken teeth; the axle skews.
On the ridge road green-lacquer Green-Seedling jolts hard in the mud.
A sideways skid overturns Green-Seedling; sides split, straw scatters.
Under the water shed Uncle Ridge lunges for the waterwheel spine and steadies the skewed axle hard.

scenes.setting: Aftermath (Green-Seedling old photo indirect · oil-paper lantern recall)

actions.action: The day after the flood Uncle Ridge stands in the South-slope water shed staring at the jammed waterwheel spine.
Uncle Ridge strokes the broken-teeth gap with a finger, expression darkened.
On a slip beside the water-log book Uncle Ridge notes the date Green-Seedling overturned.
An old photo of Green-Seedling hangs on the shed wall; Uncle Ridge gazes a long time.
Uncle Ridge takes down one of the five oil-paper lanterns under the eaves and sits alone by its faint light.
The damaged waterwheel spine still stands skewed beside the Nine-mound ridges.

scenes.setting: Teeth replaced (third state · spare small waterwheel false friend)
actions: Weeks later Uncle Ridge brings new paddles and wood wedges and begins repairing the waterwheel spine.

actions.action: From a wood chest Uncle Ridge takes a spare small waterwheel—much like the waterwheel spine but more compact.

actions: Uncle Ridge carefully replaces teeth, drives wedges, and oils again.

actions.action: The last paddle locks tight; the waterwheel spine enters its teeth-replaced state.

actions: The repaired waterwheel spine turns a water line again; Uncle Ridge watches it with relief.

scenes.setting: False friends: Iron-Ox seedling tractor and Water officer Old Qin

actions.action: An orange-red Iron-Ox seedling tractor climbs the Nine-mound ridges—nothing like the overturned Green-Seedling.
Water officer Old Qin steps onto the ridge and talks beside Uncle Ridge; the two builds are close.
Old Qin points at the Iron-Ox seedling tractor and explains the new water-delivery roster to Uncle Ridge.
The Iron-Ox seedling tractor drives off; Uncle Ridge alone watches it leave the ridge.

actions: Wind flaps the roster sheet Old Qin left behind.

scenes.setting: False friend: neighboring-mound youth Daosui who resembles Xiao Zhou

actions.action: Outside the granary comes neighboring-mound youth Daosui in a cyan-green headscarf; at a glance he somewhat resembles young Xiao Zhou.
Daosui tries transplanting, but Uncle Ridge shakes his head—he is not Xiao Zhou after all.
Daosui leaves the Nine-mound ridges with an empty seedling basket; his back fades on the ridge road.

scenes.setting: Waist-wound cane (sluice-opening gongs long-range recall)

actions.action: Years later at dusk, hard-to-bend Uncle Ridge leans on a yellow-rattan cane outside the South-slope water shed.

actions: Leaning on the cane Uncle Ridge looks up at the thatch roof, gaze distant.

actions.action: Those two sluice-opening gongs under the beam tremble lightly in the wind; Uncle Ridge stops on his cane to listen.

actions: Leaning on the cane Uncle Ridge presses his palm beside the cold brass plaque on the stone post, as if saying goodbye.
He slowly sits on the ridge stone steps, rattan cane against his knee.

scenes.setting: Xiao Zhou returns · Uncle Ridge dies

actions.action: By day, adult Xiao Zhou returns along the ridge road and hurries toward the South-slope water shed.

actions: Outside the shed Xiao Zhou reunites with cane-leaning Uncle Ridge; they embrace.

actions.action: Beside the field-hut narrow couch, Xiao Zhou holds Uncle Ridge's mud-stained yet cold hand.
Uncle Ridge's breath fades; at last he closes his eyes and dies.
Xiao Zhou gently sets Uncle Ridge's bamboo water gauge back by the couch.

scenes.setting: Relics · canal-opening brass plaque (indirect reference)

actions.action: Behind the water-shed door Uncle Ridge's dark-green straw cape still hangs; Xiao Zhou reaches to stroke it lightly.
By the stone post, adult Xiao Zhou stands before a newly nailed canal-opening brass plaque.
Xiao Zhou's fingertip traces Uncle Ridge's name engraved on the canal-opening brass plaque.

actions: Wind rises; sluice-opening gongs tremble far off; Xiao Zhou lifts his head.

scenes.setting: Reunion (adult lookalike both sides)

actions.action: Adult A-Xiang arrives from the neighboring mound and embraces Xiao Zhou tightly under the water shed.

actions: Xiao Zhou and A-Xiang stand side by side by the stone post—one calm, one playful.
They look at each other in silence, studying faces alike yet different.
A-Xiang sets down the reed-mat roll, then silently shoulders it again, only standing with Xiao Zhou.

scenes.setting: Memory flashback (temporal anchors)

actions.action: The shot returns to years ago—the youth who touched morning-mist water mirrors on the mud ridge appears again.

anchor.phrase: the youth who touched morning-mist water mirrors on the mud ridge

actions.action: The opening moment returns—by the ridge, a wooden waterwheel turns a clear water line for the first time.

anchor.phrase: the wooden waterwheel that first turned a clear water line at the opening

actions.action: Flash to that year's granary dark lane—the figure with turmeric-yellow headscarf and bamboo-joint bracelet flickers past.

anchor.phrase: the figure with turmeric-yellow headscarf in the dark lane that year

actions.action: Again that row of five old oil-paper lanterns under the eaves appears.

anchor.phrase: that row of five old oil-paper lanterns under the eaves

actions.action: Back to the winding mud ridge of first meeting; morning mist like silver thread, as before.

anchor.phrase: the Nine-mound ridges of first meeting

scenes.setting: Closing (stained water-log book · bamboo water gauges long-range)

actions.action: Xiao Zhou reopens that mud-stained water-log book and walks into the South-slope water shed.
By the water mouth, those earlier three bamboo water gauges still stand neatly stuck.
Xiao Zhou takes over watching the waterwheel spine; the water line flows into the spine trough again.

actions: Outside the shed mouth, layered terrace outlines grow clear in morning light.
